name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official requirements are available; a Biology PhD deadline, Fall 2027 GRE policy and admission model were not confirmed. The central GRE statement is explicitly for Fall 2026.

applicationFee.note: Waivers for Clark alumni, employees and applicants from partner organizations such as Fulbright, McNair, AmeriCorps, Peace Corps, City Year and Teach for America. International eligibility depends on the relevant category; no general hardship waiver was established.

english.note: International applicants submit official TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or PTE Academic scores. PhD page does not give minimum scores. Exemption requires citizenship in a listed country or an accredited degree earned with at least two years of in-person study in a listed country.

documents: Personal statement explaining graduate-study reasons, research interests, prospective faculty and professional objectives
All academic transcripts and degree confirmation, with original-language records and English translations
requirements.note: GRE not required but strongly suggested for Biology in the published Fall 2026 policy; confirm Fall 2027. Unofficial transcripts can be used for review; official final transcripts and degree proof required before enrollment. Department seeks prior independent research experience.

funding.note: The Biology doctoral page guarantees graduate students tuition remission and teaching assistantships for five years; stipend amount not stated.
